note: Models Sprite Forge uses (or has trained). Weights are downloaded by tools/fetch_models.py, not committed. Every move made with them records the models and licences in its import block. Trained models (learned motion matching, motion generators) are added here with their training data and licence.

mediapipe_pose_heavy.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (heavy)
mediapipe_pose_heavy.role: 3D world landmarks (33) for one person per crop
used_by: forge.py mocap (single person filling the frame)
mediapipe_pose_heavy.note: Not used for match footage: its own person finder misses 60-120 px players.

yolox_m_humanart.name: YOLOX-m person detector (OpenMMLab, COCO + Human-Art)
yolox_m_humanart.check: Training data includes Human-Art; confirm its terms before a commercial release.

rtmpose_l_halpe26.name: RTMPose-l body + feet (Halpe-26), OpenMMLab
rtmpose_l_halpe26.check: Trained on Body7 (COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18); confirm each dataset's terms before a commercial release.
rtmpose_l_halpe26.role: 2D body + feet keypoints on a given box (top-down), 384x288

rtmpose_m_halpe26.name: RTMPose-m body + feet (Halpe-26), OpenMMLab
rtmpose_m_halpe26.check: Trained on Body7 (COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18); confirm each dataset's terms before a commercial release.

lifter_v1.name: Sprite Forge 2D->3D pose lifter v1 (trained here)
lifter_v1.licence: MIT (derived from SkillCorner Open Data body pose, MIT)
